items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1960-07-14
items.q: A fellow by the name of Henry Ferriero played banjo, and a fellow by the name of Fitch Flick played drums.

ctx.x: There's a place, I think one day I was at the market with Bob Coquille, do you remember that? It was about the original 2 Bits Club, is that the same thing?

The original 2 Bits Club, that's it. That's right. That's what, everything was 25 cents. Did they sell whiskey? No, that was in prohibition days. They couldn't sell whiskey. That's why they charged 25 cents. A bowl of ice was 25, a Coca-Cola was 25. The sandwich was 25 cents. Anything you ordered was 25 cents. And of course if you brought your own bottle of whiskey in, you paid 25 cents for the privilege of bringing in your own whiskey. And they did pretty good business too, even at that. I also played at the…
So when you made those records with Sharky, were you working with him?
